Our story

Zeus System Technology Nig. Ltd. was founded in 2010. Its registered business covers a wide range of technology work, from IT support, software, and websites to infrastructure, hardware, security systems, data management, consultancy, and training.

That breadth shapes how we work. The same company can advise on a requirement, supply and set up the equipment or software, and support it afterwards. We treat these services as one connected portfolio, so a decision about a network, a website, or a security system is made with the rest of your technology in mind.

Registered business activities

  • IT managed services and technical support
  • Website design, development, and hosting
  • Custom software development and maintenance
  • IT infrastructure, cloud services, and networking
  • Hardware sales, installation, and repair
  • Home automation, CCTV, and security systems
  • Database management and data warehousing
  • IT consultancy and technology training
  • Hardware and software procurement and supply

Our mission

Empowering businesses and individuals with cutting-edge technology solutions, innovative consulting, and transformative training—driving digital excellence and sustainable growth.

Our vision

To be a leading technology solutions provider, recognized for innovation, excellence, and customer-centric services that drive digital transformation and business growth globally.

Core values

The principles we use to guide our work and our relationships with clients.

Innovation

We look for practical ways to apply current technology to real requirements.

Collaboration

We work with you and your team, so solutions reflect how your organization actually operates.

Excellence

We aim for careful, well-finished work in every installation, build, and repair.

Integrity

We give honest advice and clear recommendations, including when the right choice is the simpler one.

Customer-Centricity

Your requirements guide what we recommend and how we support you afterwards.

Our approach

From the first conversation to long-term support, we work in five steps. We aim for a relationship that continues after installation, built on listening first and explaining options plainly.

  1. 1

    Understand

    We start by learning how you work and what you need technology to do.

  2. 2

    Plan

    We outline practical options, with a recommendation that fits your requirements and budget.

  3. 3

    Implement

    We supply, install, build, and configure the solution so it is ready for use.

  4. 4

    Support

    We provide maintenance and technical support so your systems keep running.

  5. 5

    Improve

    We review how things are working and recommend improvements as your needs change.

Work With Us.

Tell us about your requirements and we will recommend a practical way forward.
